description: Primary Parity Before the Cutover: School management for admins and SYSTEM (ADM-03, ADM-04, SYS-05, school license view)
deviation_notes: Story S5 (teacher role change has no effect on access) is a regression found during drafting, not a triage row. Closes the tech-debt row of 2026-09-14. No schema change. Deviations: red-first skipped for several S1 tests; S4 license states are active/ended/inactive; S5 scope extended to role source fixes (users.role) in teacher reads, leaderboard, owner delete. Phase A: pairs, data checks, and gates done; kit run, captures, and look check wait for the batch (orchestrator). Fixed app-nav test for the S4 nav item. Closed 2026-10-26 (Daniel, check D2).

sprint.goal: School admins and SYSTEM staff can set up and manage the teachers, classes, imports, and license seats of a school in the app, with every write in the right school.

stories.title: Admin assigns teachers to a class
SYSTEM imports into a chosen school
SYSTEM manages the school of a teacher
Admin sees the school license (view only)
A teacher role change takes effect
